
### Install

| Your system | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Debian 13 or LMDE 7 | the file ending in `_debian13-lmde7_amd64.deb` |
| Linux Mint 22.x or Ubuntu 24.04 | the file ending in `_ubuntu24.04-mint22_amd64.deb` |

Open the downloaded file with your package installer, or run
`sudo apt install ./cinnarchy_*.deb` in the folder you saved it to. Then start
**Omarchy Theme Picker** from the Cinnamon menu.

The packages are built from this tag's source by the repository's CI.
`SHA256SUMS` lists their checksums.
